title: SafeFUME™ 360 Automatic Cyanoacrylate Fuming Chambers
meta_title: SafeFUME 360 Cyanoacrylate Fuming Chambers - Forensic Crime Lab Equipment
meta_description: The SafeFUME 360 cyanoacrylate fuming chamber creates a safe work environment for developing latent prints from non-porous surfaces. Choose from multiple sizes and configurations.
meta_keywords: cyanoacrylate fuming chamber, forensic equipment, crime lab equipment, latent print development, fingerprint processing
short_description: The SafeFUME™ 360 is used to develop latent prints from non-porous surfaces in a controlled and safe environment. Choose from small benchtop units to larger walk-in chambers.
full_description:
Using innovative filtration technology, the SafeFUME 360 cyanoacrylate fuming chamber creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the industry. Optional side and rear windows provide a 360° view of the development process. Choose from multiple sizes, from bench top to floor standing, including multi-chamber cabinets. Caster wheels are standard on all models except the bench top series, and optional UV lamp decontamination is available.
Evidence is easily positioned inside the chamber using the adjustable hanging rods. Cyanoacrylate is placed within the chamber and starting the cycle triggers the automated system that controls the hot plate, cabinet humidity, door lock, internal circulation fan, and purge cycle. The recirculatory design requires no ducting for setup. Cyanoacrylate vapors are filtered by a special carbon filter that ensures no dangerous substances are exhausted into the atmosphere air supply.
seo_content: The SafeFUME 360 cyanoacrylate fuming chamber is an essential piece of equipment for state and federal crime laboratories, crime scene investigation teams, law enforcement agencies, medical examiners' programs, and criminal justice education facilities. Its innovative filtration technology and comprehensive safety features make it the ideal solution for developing latent prints from non-porous surfaces.

Construction & Compliance.OSHA Compliance: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood. Please consult your Safety Officer and/or Industrial Hygienist.
